svg.text: SRA-16 Silent AC Rack - Dimplex GDC14RBA bay + 16 RU acoustic rack
CONCEPT - verify AC dims (Note 1) before cutting
DRAIN D16 barb (to floor waste / pump)
Cold supply: AC outlet > hood > front plenum > IT
Hot return: IT > rear plenum > shelf > AC upper grille
Room air: plinth > lined riser > AC lower grille
Condenser exhaust: spigot > elbow > rear wall
1. AC reference geometry = Dimplex GDC14RBA (label 476W x 358D x 840H, 31.5 kg).
Notch, grille split (~420), spigot and outlet sizes are photo/manual
estimates - tape-check (docs/DESIGN.md s.3) before cutting panels.
2. Walls: 1.2 steel skins (laser cut, CP-SRA16-SMP-001) + 3 MLV + 30 foam
(FR) on a welded 30x30 SHS frame (CP-SRA16-FRM-001). Joints sealed.
3. Closed loop: cold and hot zones separated by the shelf, hood, IT +
blanking panels and air dams. Verified by voxel flood-fill (zone_check).
4. Condenser zone below partition draws room air through the plinth
labyrinth; exhaust D150 insulated duct to rear spigot -> outdoors.
5. Docking seals: EPDM gaskets + brush strip at AC back (Y=417), AC
held back by retention bar; hood drop-collar seals on AC top.
6. Drip tray 1.2 SS full bay floor; AC drain + tray -> 16 mm hose, fall
to floor waste or condensate pump. Leak sensor in tray.
7. 19in rails EIA-310, 700 mm rail spacing; blank all unused RU.
8. External 622.4 W x 1072.4 D x 1870.4 H (+ handles 36, spigot 60).
ISO - DOORS + RIGHT SIDE REMOVED (not to scale)
